# Multiple Monitor Mounts

## Up your productivity and optimize your workspace with a monitor mount for two, three or even four displays.

### About Multiple Monitor Mounts from Ergotron

Dual-monitor arms and dual-monitor stands show quick [ROI payback](https://www.ergotron.com/en-us/tools/payback-calculator) by placing more information where it's needed. Add even more screen space to your workstation with a 3-monitor or 4-monitor mount. [Engineered for superior quality](https://www.ergotron.com/en-us/company/quality-tested) and safety tested, our monitor mounts perform dependably for years (whether in medical imaging, gaming or office applications), which is how we can offer our [robust warranty](https://www.ergotron.com/en-us/support/warranty-policy).
